Microsoft's MRT Core (Modern Resource Technology), vendored for NovaOS
=====================================================================

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/WindowsAppSDK (MIT, LICENSE),
commit 0cf06784786e1e18d25099ca1d2e3dbeefce677e, its dev/MRTCore/mrt tree.
Kept, unchanged: mrt/mrm/include and mrt/mrm/mrmmin (the resources.pri
reader: the file and section formats, the hierarchical names, the
decisions, the resource maps), mrt/Core/src (MRM.dll: the flat C API,
MrmCreateResourceManager, MrmLoadStringResource...) and LICENSE.  Left
out: the NuGet packages.config files, the tests, the build-time tools.

userland/mrm/build.py compiles mrmmin.vcxproj's sources and MRM.cpp into
NovaOS's MRM.dll with MRM.def's exports (one header line clang will not
take as MSVC does is patched in the build's copy, not here).  shlwapi's
SHLoadIndirectString reads app packages' "ms-resource:" strings with it;
tools/appx/makepri.py writes .pri files in the format it reads.

To update: replace mrt/ with a newer commit's (the same three folders)
and rebuild; build.py fails if its header patch no longer applies.
